name: product-film-kit
description: Skills for making product launch films with Claude Code, distilled from a real production.

plugins.name: product-film
plugins.description: Make a fast, music-driven product launch film for a SaaS landing page with /product-film: measure the track before the storyboard, cut on measured lifts, peak-aligned SFX, every claim traced to the page, safe offline real-app capture, AI illustrations but never AI product UI, and scripted gates (claims, every-frame OCR, reading time, music lift, SFX onset, loudness).
